$FileDialog.popup_centered()

_No response_
comments: Is this also an issue in 3.4.3?
No, I only seen it on master.

This is what it looks like on 3.4.3:
![Godot_v3 4 3-stable_win64_U8cUCHj8rK](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/25117425/156937738-eb25ba13-b8dc-47c5-a607-b0d3656d52a0.png)

Ah, I checked again and indeed it's bugged in 3.x too. But you can easily resize the dialog, because it's a Control, so the issue isn't as apparent. In 4.0 the visibility option is more hidden and even if you show the dialog, you can't interact with it. You need to change the values in the inspector.

> even if you show the dialog, you can't interact with it

I can interact with it in 4.0:

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/25117425/156938419-97dd39ca-9990-4563-80c5-c99442efe1e0.mp4
But I mean in the editor. It's possible to fix the dialog size after it appears, but perfectly it should have correct size from the start.

review_comments: This seems like a very brute force solution to me, and ignores things like scaling, I think the solution is elsewhere and that the size isn't computed correctly from the contents
The size is computed correctly. It's the minimum size, which is used if you don't override it.
